title: What sets range and charging speed
narration: Driving range starts with pack size, measured in kilowatt-hours of stored energy. The long-range Tesla Model Y, America's best-selling electric car in 2025, holds about 81 kilowatt-hours. Chevrolet's electric Equinox holds 85, and the long-range Hyundai Ioniq 5 holds 84. Each is officially rated at over 300 miles in its longest-range version. Refill speed depends on the power the car and the charger can handle. At best, on a powerful fast charger, the Ioniq 5 goes from 10 to 80 percent in about 20 minutes. And a cold battery delivers less power and energy.
